about: 【Update Details】 ●Boost the fun with the Bonus Gates guided by Bob!
Bub's twin brother, Bob, makes an appearance to support Bub's adventure!
In Bob's Room within the Dungeon, you can choose your destination from 3 exciting Bonus Gates!

The 3 choices are the Item Room where you can obtain lots of treasure chests and items, the Combo Room where you can defeat enemies all at once to rack up combos, and the Skip Gate where you can skip multiple floors at once.
Enjoy your adventure while choosing the perfect bonus for you at that moment!
